[EN] All of these children were born here, and as a result, they have the Sight. They see with truly divine clarity...but only when they sleep.

Our research suggests it has something to do with the sap of the Sorrow Tree.
[ES] Todos estos niños nacieron aquí y, como resultado, tienen la Visión. Ven con una claridad verdaderamente divina... pero solo cuando duermen.

Nuestra investigación sugiere que tiene algo que ver con la savia del Sorrow Tree.

[EN] Geez, what on earth is going on?
[ES] Vaya, ¿qué diablos está pasando?
